name: Antigua and Barbuda
summary: A red field with an inverted triangle containing a golden rising sun over black, blue and white bands. Designed by the artist and teacher Reginald Samuel, it was adopted in 1967 when the islands became an associated state.
origin: In 1966 a competition was held for a flag for the new Associated State of Antigua; more than 600 designs were submitted. Reginald Samuel's design was adopted on 27 February 1967 and kept at full independence on 1 November 1981.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The dynamism and energy of the people.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: The African heritage of the people.

symbols.name: Rising sun
symbols.description: A golden sun with seven rays rising over the black band.
symbols.meaning: The dawn of a new era.

symbols.name: V shape
symbols.description: The red sides form a V around the triangle.

history.label: Associated State and independent Antigua and Barbuda

facts: The combination of gold, blue and white is often summarised as 'sun, sea and sand'.
clues: A red flag with a V-shaped triangle holding a rising gold sun over black, blue and white.
Its colours are summed up as sun, sea and sand.
Its red sides form a V for victory.
